svg.text: 1 · Chunk 1: an EXTEND batch with t0–t3 of request D
request D has a 10-token prompt · chunked_prefill_size 4 in this example
REQ_TO_TOKEN: KV SLOT OF EACH POSITION · THE ROW STAYS WITH D BETWEEN CHUNKS
PrefillAdder fills rem_chunk_tokens with t0–t3 and remembers D as chunked_req.
Running decode requests wait: this forward is an EXTEND batch (no mixed chunk by default).
